description: THE DECISION for a wallet, in one paid call — should you settle an invoice to this address? Returns a 0-100 risk score, a PAY / CAUTION / AVOID verdict, the exact evidence that moved the score (buying power, transaction history, contract status, recent payer pattern), and the next action to take. Built for agents that pay other agents: x402 seller vetting, prepay-or-not calls, invoice risk caps, airdrop allowlist screening. Underlying facts are included so the caller can re-d
name: akari_wallet_verdict
